manifestations.description: Both sides of my skull are caved in badly.
A very bad running nose whenever I eat (embarrassing) and loss of feeling of the nose.
Impaired mental acuity; thinking is slow and difficult.

treatments_received: Emergency bilateral craniotomies and evacuation of clot
Extension of right parietal craniotomy to a large decompressive craniectomy
Chest tube insertion on the left side
Repair of lacerated upper lip and packing of nasal cavity
treatments_future: Assessment by specialist: HK$500 to 800 per session, at monthly interval.
CT brain at HK2,000/scan. MR brain (preferred) at HK$5,000/scan.
Revision of shunt: total cost at HK$100,000.

losses.description: Impaired mental acuity, thinking is slow and difficult.
Both sides of my skull are caved in badly.

losses.category: Loss of ability to enjoy food and drink
losses.description: A very bad running nose whenever I eat which is very embarrassing as I am unaware of it due to loss of feeling of the nose.
Serious head injuries including extradural and subdural haematomas, multiple intracerebral bleeds and skull fractures.
The Plaintiff required care by his wife, who left employment to take care of him from August 2000 to March 2001.
